disposition_reason: Table 4 prints nickel, lead, cadmium, cobalt, zinc, copper, manganese and iron (mg/kg wet weight, AAS) for 28 apple varieties sold in a Lipetsk retail chain; Table 6 gives means by ripening group.

study.design: Retail survey of apple varieties for bioactive substances and elements
study.origin: Not stated per variety; some varieties from the Krasnodar region (text)
study.period_text: Studies conducted 2016-2018; fruits analyzed in October
study.method: Atomic absorption spectrometry (Spectrum-5); digestion not described
study.qa: No CRM, recovery, LOD or replicate information reported

unresolved: Text says 35 varieties were studied; Table 4 lists 28.
Zeros in Table 4 have no stated detection limit; recorded as not detected.
Lead values up to 4.824 mg/kg wet weight and cadmium 0.112 mg/kg are far above typical apple levels; no QA data to judge them.
Assignment of varieties to summer/autumn/winter groups is not given, so Table 6 cannot be reconciled with Table 4.
Sample preparation (peeled or not, digestion) and number of fruits per variety are not described.
